title: School Decision Stakeholder Match
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Match ten school decisions to the stakeholder who typically holds them: teacher, principal, district administrator, school board, or family.

educational.topic: Stakeholders and decision rights in a school district
learningObjectives: The learner will classify ten school decisions by the stakeholder who typically holds the decision, correctly matching at least eight of ten on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The roles of parent and family, teacher, principal, school administrator, and school board, from Chapter 2.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Who has the authority to make this decision?
Is this a classroom, school, district, or family decision?
commonMisconceptions: The principal decides everything at a school
The school board runs daily operations
Families have no decisions of their own
assessmentOpportunities: Does the school board set one school's bell schedule?
Name one decision that belongs to families.

controls.name: Five stakeholder buttons
controls.description: Choose Teacher, Principal, District administrator, School board, or Parent and family for the current decision.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Shows or hides the one-line description of each role.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next decision after feedback.

controls.name: Previous missed and Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, step through the decisions you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the decisions for a practice run.
